market_context: United States/general English; refrigerated storage of cooked salmon
title: How long does cooked salmon last in the fridge?

seo.title: How long does cooked salmon last in the fridge?
seo.meta_description: Cooked salmon follows the general cooked-fish rule: 3–4 days refrigerated at 40 °F or below when chilled promptly after cooking.
seo.search_intent: Learn how many days cooked salmon keeps refrigerated and when to freeze leftovers.

excerpt: Cooked salmon can be refrigerated for 3–4 days at 40 °F (4 °C) or below under USDA guidance for cooked fish and seafood. Refrigerate it within about two hours after cooking and freeze portions early if they will not be used within that window.
content_html:
Salmon does not get a longer refrigerator window because it is oily fish. USDA's cooked-seafood guidance is 3–4 days at 40 °F/4 °C or below.

Count from the day it was cooked

Salmon cooked on Monday should generally be used by Thursday or Friday when it was chilled promptly and kept cold.

Refrigerate within two hours

Perishable foods should be chilled within about 2 hours, or within one hour above 90 °F. Shallow containers cool portions faster.

Smell does not extend the clock

Sour, rancid or ammonia-like odor is a discard sign. But normal smell on day five or six does not prove the salmon is still within safe storage guidance.

Can cooked salmon be eaten cold?

Yes, if it was cooked and stored safely. Reheating is not required for a cold salad or sandwich. When leftovers are reheated, USDA uses 165 °F as the target.

Freeze extra portions

USDA lists about 3 months as a best-quality target for cooked fish in the freezer. Freezing early usually preserves better quality than waiting until refrigerator day four.

Bottom line

Use cooked salmon within 3–4 refrigerated days. Chill promptly and freeze what will not be eaten in that period.

faq.question: Can I eat cooked salmon after five days?
faq.answer: USDA's conservative cooked-seafood window is 3–4 days, so discarding it after five days is safer.

faq.question: Can leftover salmon be eaten cold?
faq.answer: Yes, if it was cooked and refrigerated safely and remains within the storage window.

faq.question: How long does cooked salmon keep frozen?
faq.answer: USDA lists about 3 months for best quality of cooked fish.
